instruction: nx.nonisomorphic_trees(order) and nx.number_of_nonisomorphic_trees(order) (networkx/generators/nonisomorphic_trees.py) raise a bare ValueError for every order below 2. Give them consistent semantics for small orders: order 0 has no trees (number_of_nonisomorphic_trees(0) == 0 and the generator yields nothing), order 1 has exactly one, the single-node graph nx.empty_graph(1) (count 1, the generator yields that one graph), and only a negative order raises ValueError('order must be non-negative'), from the count and from the generator (on its first next()). For every order the generator yields exactly number_of_nonisomorphic_trees(order) trees, each with order nodes and none isomorphic to another; larger orders behave as before. Document the behavior and add tests.
